description: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text; 3:1 for large text (18px+ or 14px+ bold)
do: Use tools like WebAIM contrast checker; test in both light and dark modes
dont: Use gray-on-gray or low-contrast decorative text for UI labels

description: Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements; 2-4px outline or custom style
do: Apply focus:ring-2 or custom focus visible styles; never remove outline without replacement
dont: Remove outline with outline:none without providing custom alternative

description: Descriptive alt text for all meaningful images; empty alt for decorative
do: Write alt text describing image purpose not just appearance; empty alt="" for decorations
dont: Omit alt attributes or use filename as alt text

description: All interactive elements must have accessible names; icon-only buttons need aria-label
do: Add aria-label to icon buttons; use accessibilityLabel in React Native
dont: Use tooltip as only accessible name; leave icon buttons unlabeled

description: All functionality accessible by keyboard; tab order matches visual order
do: Test all features with keyboard only; ensure logical tab sequence
dont: Create mouse-only interactions; skip focus management

description: Proper heading hierarchy h1 through h6 without skipping levels
do: Use one h1 per page; h2 for sections; h3 for subsections
dont: Skip from h1 to h3; use headings for visual styling only

description: Never convey information through color alone; add icon or text
do: Use checkmark + green for success; error icon + red for errors
dont: Use red alone for errors; green alone for success

description: Provide skip navigation link for keyboard users to jump to main content
do: Add hidden visible-on-focus skip link at top of page
dont: Require keyboard users to tab through entire navigation every page

description: Support system font size scaling; test at 200% font size
do: Use relative units em/rem; test layouts with large text
dont: Use fixed px for font sizes; truncate text as it grows

description: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query; disable or reduce animations
do: Wrap animations in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) check
dont: Play decorative animations ignoring user motion preferences

description: Ensure screen reader compatibility; logical reading order; descriptive labels
do: Test with VoiceOver (iOS) and TalkBack (Android); verify reading order
dont: Rely on visual order alone; skip accessibility testing with actual screen reader

description: Every form input must have associated visible label using label element
do: Use label with for matching input id; use aria-labelledby for complex inputs
dont: Use placeholder as only label; remove labels for visual reasons

description: Minimum 44x44pt on iOS; 48x48dp on Android for all interactive elements
do: Extend hit area beyond visual bounds using padding or hitSlop
dont: Create 20px icon buttons without extended tap area

description: Minimum 8px gap between interactive elements to prevent mis-taps
do: Add 8dp minimum margin between buttons and links
dont: Stack tappable elements directly adjacent without gap

description: Use tap/click as primary interaction; don't rely on hover-only for mobile
do: Design interactions that work without hover; hover is progressive enhancement
dont: Show critical information only on hover with no tap equivalent

description: Disable submit/action button during async operations; show loading indicator
do: Add disabled state and loading spinner during API calls; re-enable on complete
dont: Allow multiple submissions by not disabling; no loading feedback

description: Eliminate 300ms tap delay on web for better responsiveness
do: Add touch-action:manipulation to remove browser tap delay
dont: Leave default browser touch delay for tap-heavy interfaces

description: Avoid gesture conflicts between app and system gestures
do: Design swipe interactions that don't conflict with back gesture or Control Center
dont: Use horizontal swipe on full-screen modal that conflicts with back navigation

description: Use haptic feedback for key confirmations and important state changes
do: Trigger impact haptic on successful form submit; notification haptic for alerts
dont: Overuse haptic for every small interaction or decorative moments

description: Respect device safe areas; keep content away from notch Dynamic Island and home indicator
do: Use SafeAreaView or CSS env(safe-area-inset) to pad content
dont: Place buttons or content under notch or home indicator gesture bar

description: Use modern formats WebP/AVIF; implement responsive images with srcset
do: Serve WebP with JPEG fallback; use next/image for automatic optimization
dont: Serve unoptimized raw PNG/JPEG at full resolution

description: Lazy load images and components below the fold
do: Add loading="lazy" to images; use React.lazy for route splitting
dont: Eagerly load all images and all JavaScript on initial page load

description: Virtualize lists with 50 or more items
do: Use FlatList on React Native; react-window or TanStack Virtual on web
dont: Render all 500 list items into DOM simultaneously

description: Reserve space for async content to prevent CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift)
do: Set explicit width/height on images; skeleton screens for loading content
dont: Load content that pushes page elements causing layout jump

description: Split JavaScript bundles by route to reduce initial load time
do: Use Next.js dynamic() or React.lazy + Suspense for route-level splitting
dont: Load entire application JavaScript bundle on first page visit

description: Prevent invisible text during font loading using font-display swap
do: Add font-display:swap in @font-face; preload critical fonts in head
dont: Leave default font-display which causes FOIT (Flash Of Invisible Text)

description: Throttle or debounce high-frequency events like scroll resize and input
do: Debounce search input by 300ms; throttle scroll handlers to 16ms
dont: Attach unthrottled resize handler that recalculates layout 100x per second

description: Use skeleton screens instead of long spinners for content loading
do: Show skeleton shimmer for content loading over 300ms
dont: Show empty page or just spinner for long data loads

description: Maintain consistent visual style across all pages and components
do: Create design tokens; document component patterns in storybook or docs
dont: Change border-radius style between pages; mix flat and skeuomorphic

description: Use SVG icon sets not emoji for UI controls and navigation
do: Use Lucide React HeroIcons or platform icons; consistent stroke weight
dont: Use emoji for navigation icons buttons or functional UI elements

description: Visual effects like shadows blur and radius should match chosen style
do: Glassmorphism uses backdrop-filter; flat design uses no shadow; neumorphism uses dual shadow
dont: Add blur effects to flat design; use hard shadows with glassmorphism

description: Design light and dark mode together; don't invert light colors for dark
do: Use desaturated lighter tonal variants in dark mode; test contrast separately
dont: Simply invert light mode colors for dark mode; assume same contrast

description: Set correct viewport meta tag; never disable user zoom
do: Add meta viewport content="width=device-width initial-scale=1"
dont: Use maximum-scale=1 or user-scalable=no which disables zoom

description: Design mobile layout first then scale up to tablet and desktop
do: Start CSS with mobile styles; add larger breakpoints with min-width media queries
dont: Design desktop first and add mobile overrides with max-width queries

description: No horizontal scroll on mobile; content must fit within viewport width
do: Test on 375px viewport; use overflow-x:hidden as safety net on body
dont: Use fixed pixel widths for cards or containers that overflow small screens

description: Use 4pt or 8dp incremental spacing system for all margins and padding
do: Define spacing tokens: 4 8 12 16 24 32 48 64px; use consistently
dont: Use arbitrary spacing values like 13px 22px 37px with no system

description: Minimum 16px body text on mobile to prevent iOS auto-zoom on inputs
do: Set body font-size at 16px minimum; use 1rem default
dont: Use 14px body text on mobile; use 14px inputs which trigger iOS zoom

description: Use consistent max-width for content containers on desktop
do: Apply max-w-6xl or max-w-7xl with mx-auto for page containers
dont: Let content stretch to full 2560px monitor width without container

description: Use 1.5 to 1.75 line height for body text for readability
do: Set body line-height:1.6 or 1.7; tighter for headings (1.2-1.3)
dont: Use line-height:1 or very tight 1.2 for body paragraph text

description: Use consistent type scale like 12 14 16 18 24 32 48 64
do: Define type scale tokens and use consistently across app
dont: Use arbitrary font sizes like 13px 17px 22px with no scale

description: Use semantic color tokens not raw hex values in components
do: Define primary secondary error success surface tokens; map to actual colors
dont: Hardcode #2563EB directly in component styles without token

description: 150-300ms for micro-interactions; up to 400ms for complex transitions
do: Set transition duration 150ms for hover states; 300ms for modal enter
dont: Use 1000ms slow transitions or 0ms instant state changes

description: Animate only transform and opacity properties for 60fps performance
do: Use transform:translateX() and opacity for all animations
dont: Animate top/left/width/height which trigger layout recalculation

description: Use ease-out for entering; ease-in for exiting; no linear for UI
do: Apply cubic-bezier(0.25 0 0 1) for natural enter; reverse for exit
dont: Use linear easing for UI transitions; it feels mechanical and robotic

description: Show skeleton or progress indicator after 300ms loading
do: Show shimmer skeleton after 300ms of data loading
dont: Show empty blank screen while data loads; no loading indicator at all

description: Use spring physics curves for natural feeling animations in mobile
do: Use spring animation in React Native Animated or Reanimated
dont: Use linear or cubic-bezier only for all animations in native apps

description: Every input field must have a visible text label; not placeholder only
do: Use label element associated with input; floating label is acceptable
dont: Use placeholder text as the only label which disappears on focus

description: Show validation errors directly below the related field
do: Position error message immediately after input with aria-live alert
dont: Show all errors only at top of form; show errors before user interacts

description: Validate on blur not on each keystroke; show error after user leaves field
do: Trigger validation onBlur event; clear error when user begins correcting
dont: Show real-time error messages as user types each character

description: Auto-dismiss informational toasts in 3-5 seconds; error toasts need manual dismiss
do: Use 4s for success toasts; leave error toasts until user dismisses
dont: Keep success toasts visible until user dismisses; dismiss errors automatically

description: Require explicit confirmation before destructive irreversible actions
do: Show "Are you sure? This cannot be undone" dialog for deletes
dont: Delete records immediately on first click without confirmation

description: Show helpful empty state with explanation and call-to-action
do: Show illustration + friendly message + primary action for empty state
dont: Show blank empty screen with no explanation or next step

description: Reveal complex form options progressively; show basic form first
do: Show advanced options behind "Show more" or stepper navigation
dont: Show all 20 form fields simultaneously on first visit

description: Provide show/hide password toggle in password fields
do: Add eye icon button to toggle password visibility
dont: Force users to type password blind with no way to verify

description: Maximum 5 items in bottom navigation; always include text label with icon
do: Keep bottom nav to 3-5 items; label every icon with text
dont: Put 8 items in bottom nav; use icon-only bottom navigation without labels

description: Back navigation must be predictable; preserve scroll position and state
do: Return to same scroll position on back; preserve form state navigation
dont: Reset scroll to top on back navigation; clear form state when navigating away

description: All important screens must support deep linking via URL or URI scheme
do: Implement React Navigation deep links; handle URL parameters for state
dont: App screens not reachable via URL; no sharing or push notification deep links

description: Current navigation location must be visually highlighted with color and indicator
do: Highlight active tab with primary color + active indicator dot or underline
dont: All navigation items appear identical with no active state indicator

description: Modals must have clear close affordance; support swipe-down to dismiss
do: Show X close button in modal header; support swipe-down gesture on sheets
dont: Full-screen modals with no close button and no gesture to dismiss

description: Web: use breadcrumbs for 3+ level deep hierarchies
do: Add breadcrumb navigation on product detail and deep content pages
dont: Omit breadcrumbs on sites with 4+ hierarchy levels leaving users lost

description: Preserve scroll position filter state and form input when navigating back
do: Store and restore scroll position on back navigation; keep filter selections
dont: Clear all user selections and scroll position every time user navigates back

description: Large screens prefer sidebar; small screens use bottom or top navigation
do: Render sidebar on 1024px+ breakpoint; bottom nav on mobile
dont: Show bottom navigation on desktop; show small mobile tabs on large screen

description: Match chart type to the type of data being visualized
do: Use line chart for time series; bar chart for comparison; pie for proportion
dont: Use pie chart for comparing many categories; line chart for unrelated categories

description: Always show chart legend near the chart visible without scrolling
do: Position legend above or to the right of chart; interactive to toggle series
dont: Place legend below a fold requiring scroll; use no legend at all

description: Show tooltips with exact values on hover (web) or tap (mobile)
do: Implement custom tooltip with formatted value + date + label
dont: Show chart with no way to see exact values; visual shape only

description: Charts must reflow and simplify on small screens
do: Reduce tick density; use horizontal bar instead of vertical on mobile
dont: Render same chart regardless of screen size causing unreadable labels

description: Avoid pie charts for more than 5 categories
do: Switch to horizontal bar chart when comparing 6+ categories
dont: Use 12-slice pie chart with tiny unreadable segments

description: Show meaningful empty state when chart has no data
do: Show "No data available yet" with illustration and guidance action
dont: Render empty chart axes with no data and no explanation

description: Use accessible color palettes for charts; colorblind-safe combinations
do: Use pattern or shape + color together; avoid red-green only pairs
dont: Distinguish all chart data using only red and green colors

description: Keep per-frame JavaScript work under 16ms for 60fps performance
do: Move heavy computation to Web Workers; use requestAnimationFrame for DOM updates
dont: Run expensive calculations synchronously in event handlers blocking scroll

description: Provide offline state messaging and graceful degradation
do: Show offline banner; cache critical data; allow offline read of cached content
dont: Show cryptic error or blank screen when user goes offline

description: Never block user interaction during animations; keep UI responsive
do: Allow user to tap buttons and navigate during transition animations
dont: Lock entire UI during page transition animation until complete

description: Stagger list item entrance animations by 30-50ms per item
do: Apply 50ms delay increment to list items entering view
dont: Animate all 20 list items simultaneously or with same delay

description: Exit animations should be 60-70% duration of enter animations
do: Enter: 300ms ease-out; Exit: 200ms ease-in for responsive feel
dont: Use same duration for both enter and exit making exits feel slow

description: Enable browser autofill with proper autocomplete attributes
do: Add autocomplete="email" autocomplete="current-password" etc to inputs
dont: Set autocomplete="off" for all form fields preventing autofill

description: Allow undoing destructive or bulk actions via toast with Undo action
do: Show "Item deleted - Undo" toast with 5s window to reverse action
dont: Delete immediately with no way to recover; require filing support ticket

description: Multi-step forms must show progress indicator and allow back navigation
do: Show step 2 of 4 indicator; provide back button to previous step
dont: Show multi-step form with no indicator of total steps or current position

description: Use notification badges sparingly on navigation items; clear on visit
do: Show count badge on Messages tab for unread; clear when tab visited
dont: Show badge on every tab always; never clear badges after user visits

description: When actions exceed space use overflow menu instead of cramming
do: Show primary 2 actions inline + three-dot overflow for additional actions
dont: Cram 6 tiny action icons into toolbar until each is 16x16

description: Define systematic z-index scale rather than arbitrary high values
do: Define tokens: modal:1000 drawer:900 overlay:800 dropdown:700 tooltip:600
dont: Set z-index:9999999 randomly on one component breaking entire stack

description: Use dynamic viewport units dvh on mobile to handle browser chrome
do: Use min-h-dvh for full-height sections; avoid 100vh on mobile
dont: Use 100vh on mobile which includes hidden browser chrome causing overflow

description: Avoid nested scroll regions that conflict with primary page scroll
do: Use full page scroll; contain horizontal scroll to carousels only
dont: Nest scrollable div inside scrollable page on mobile touch devices

description: Provide cancel and back navigation in all modal and multi-step flows
do: Add Cancel button in all dialogs; Escape key closes modal; X in corner
dont: Modal with no way to close except completing the flow entirely

description: Provide immediate visual feedback on press within 100ms
do: Change button opacity or background color on press immediately
dont: No visual change when user taps a button leaving them unsure it worked

description: Declare explicit width and height on all images to prevent layout shift
do: Add width and height attributes; use aspect-ratio CSS as alternative
dont: Load images without dimensions causing layout reflow as image loads

description: Use font weight to reinforce visual hierarchy systematically
do: Headings 700; body 400; labels and UI text 500; captions 400
dont: Use same font weight throughout entire interface flattening hierarchy

description: Use tabular/monospaced figures for prices amounts and timer displays
do: Apply font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums for price columns and live counters
dont: Use proportional figures in tables causing column misalignment

description: Use whitespace intentionally to group related elements and create breathing room
do: Use generous spacing between sections; tighter between related items
dont: Make every section same spacing with no visual grouping logic

description: Modals should animate from their trigger source with scale and fade
do: Scale from trigger button + fade in for modal enter animation
dont: Modals appear with no animation or random directional animation

description: Support system gesture navigation without conflict in native apps
do: Allow iOS swipe-back gesture in all navigable screens; test Android back
dont: Intercept swipe-back gesture for your own gesture without fallback

description: Preserve system and accessibility keyboard shortcuts; don't override
do: Don't override Ctrl+C Cmd+Z or screen reader shortcuts; document custom ones
dont: Override browser defaults like Ctrl+W or Cmd+Q with app shortcuts

description: Swipe actions must show clear affordance; don't rely on undiscoverable gesture
do: Show swipe hint with arrow or partial reveal; include tutorial on first use
dont: Hide critical functionality exclusively behind undocumented swipe gesture

description: Provide visual feedback within 100ms of any tap for responsiveness
do: Apply active state style immediately on touchstart; before any async action
dont: Only update UI after async response returns which could take 2+ seconds

description: Error messages must include actionable recovery path not just error statement
do: Show "Email already registered - Sign in instead" with link to sign in
dont: Show "Error 409 Conflict" with no explanation of what user can do next

description: Axis ticks must not be crowded; auto-skip on small screens
do: Reduce to 5-6 tick marks on mobile; use abbreviated labels like Jan Mar May
dont: Show all 12 month labels on 320px screen with overlapping text

description: Move focus to main content heading after page navigation for screen readers
do: Call focus() on main content element or h1 after route change
dont: Leave focus on nav link after navigation requiring screen reader to re-traverse nav

description: Group related form fields logically using fieldset or visual grouping
do: Group billing address fields together; separate from payment method fields
dont: Scatter related fields randomly throughout long form with no grouping

description: Use a pixel threshold before initiating drag to prevent accidental drags
do: Start drag after 10px movement threshold; treat as tap if under threshold
dont: Start drag immediately on touchstart causing accidental drags on scroll

description: Ensure layout remains usable in landscape mode on mobile devices
do: Test all screens in landscape; adjust layout for wider shorter viewport
dont: Design only for portrait mode; landscape breaks layout or is unreadable
